reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000134 (the melody read from 000134a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 14); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William Knapp has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1738, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000134a.nwc).
